<issue>
MONITOR never decrements ConnectionContext::subscriptions
`ConnectionContext::EnableMonitoring` in `src/server/conn_context.h` increments `subscriptions` when MONITOR starts, but the counter is never decremented when MONITOR stops — `ChangeMonitor()` runs the same increment on both paths:

```cpp
void EnableMonitoring(bool enable) {
  subscriptions++;  // required to support the monitoring
  monitor = enable;
}
```

Found while implementing the RESET command (#7760).


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, grep for EnableMonitoring and 'monitor' uses in src/server (conn_context.h/.cc, dragonfly_connection.cc, main_service.cc, server_family.cc). Report the code of EnableMonitoring and every call site with surrounding lines.

Note that `subscriptions++` runs on every call, including enable=false.","Only call site: conn_context.cc:123 `EnableMonitoring(start);`, the last line of ConnectionContext::ChangeMonitor(bool start) (conn_context.cc:104-124).","ChangeMonitor context (conn_context.cc:104-123): it returns early if `start == monitor` (line 106, for idempotency when MONITOR is queued in MULTI/EXEC). It then calls `my_monitors.Add(conn())` or `my_monitors.Remove(conn())` on ServerState::tlocal()->Monitors(). Next it runs `shard_set->pool()->AwaitBrief` to call NotifyChangeCount(start) on every thread, and finally calls EnableMonitoring(start).","conn_context.h:335 declares `void ChangeMonitor(bool start);`. conn_context.h:347 declares `bool monitor = false;`.","main_service.cc:239-243: DeactivateMonitoring calls `server_ctx->ChangeMonitor(false)` if server_ctx->monitor is set. It is called at main_service.cc:1872 and main_service.cc:2915.","main_service.cc:2642-2648: Service::Monitor calls `cmd_cntx->server_conn_cntx()->ChangeMonitor(true)`. It is registered as the MONITOR command at main_service.cc:2996 with ACL kMonitor (defined at 2956).","main_service.cc:1377-1380: when `dfly_cntx.monitor` is set, only RESET and QUIT are allowed.","main_service.cc:1639-1641: if `ss.Monitors()` is non-empty and `cid->CanBeMonitored()`, the command goes to DispatchMonitor(cntx, cid, tail_args). main_service.cc:2543-2545 also calls DispatchMonitor(cntx, exec_cid_, {}) when monitors exist.","main_service.cc:320-330: DispatchMonitor builds a message with MakeMonitorMessage (defined at 295).
